description: Start a 3D generation and return its job id at once. mode picks the input: text (prompt), image (options with the image URL), multiview (several view images), sketch, or model (edit an existing 3D model). The model ids and their option names are in the model catalog. This spends credits; a price estimate beforehand charges nothing. A stable idempotency_key on a retry replays the same job instead of billing twice. The job runs in the background, and its status and files are read by its job id.

expected_credits.description: The credits a price estimate answered for this request. If the price has moved since, nothing is started or charged and the error (price_changed) gives the new price.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same value when retrying this exact request.

mode.description: Which input the model is given.

model.description: A 3D model id from the model catalog.

options.description: Model-specific options; the field names of each scene are in the model catalog (include_inputs).

name: generate_3d

deduped.description: True when an earlier call with the same idempotency key already started this job: nothing was charged again.

job_id.description: The id of the started job.

outputs.description: How many results this job makes.

status.description: pending and processing are running; success, partial, failed and canceled are final. 'partial' means some outputs finished and the rest were refunded.

title: Generate a 3D model
